subject: general
question: A watch seller marks 20 percent more on the price of the watch and allows 10 percent discount at the time of sale, then what percent profit or loss will he make?
solution:
**Given:**

A watch seller marks more on the price = 20%

Discount = 10%

**Formula used:**

Profit = SP – CP

Profit% = Profit/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the CP of watch be Rs. 100

Marked price of watch = Rs. (100 + 20) = Rs. 120

Now,

SP of watch = Rs. (90% of 120)

⇒ Rs. (90/100 × 120)

⇒ Rs. 108

Now,

Profit = (SP – CP)

⇒ Rs. (108 – 100)

⇒ Rs. 8

Profit% = Profit/CP × 100

⇒ (8/100 × 100)

⇒ 8%

**∴ The required profit is 8 percent profit**
